app_subtitle: Every show logged, every euro under control, every model in the right place in the ranking.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to Private Diary
welcome.text: Your private diary of cam shows. To start, tell us which sites you buy shows on.
welcome.hint: Only these will appear in the form. Mondo Cam Girls also enables automatic import, online models and photos; for the other sites you can import your history from CSV. You can change this later in Settings › Manage sites.

controls.mcg_tip_online: Mondo Cam Girls is reachable. Click to check again.
controls.mcg_tip_offline: Mondo Cam Girls is unreachable ({motivo}). Click to check again.

actions.sync_hint: Reads only the first page of your MCG transactions (the latest 100) and imports the new shows. It is quick: use it after every show. You need to log in in the MCG window.
actions.sync_all_hint: Reads every page of your MCG transactions, from newest to oldest, and imports everything that is missing. Use it the first time or to recover old shows: it can take a few minutes and shows a summary to confirm before saving. You need to log in in the MCG window.
actions.folder_hint: Opens the folder with the archive, settings and log
actions.export_hint: Save a backup of all data to a file
actions.import_hint: Restore the data from a backup file

form.title: 📹 Add show
form.repeat_last_hint: Fill duration, cost, tags and details as in the last show with her
form.verify_rate_hint: Opens Google with the current exchange rate: compare it with the site's rate
form.editing: ✏️ You are editing the show of {data} with {nome}
form.teams_email_hint: With the model's Teams email, a click on the nickname opens the chat directly; with a username the click copies it and opens Teams, where you search for it.
form.note_rating: Click again to clear the rating; without a rating it stays TBD.
form.note_camera: How she held the camera. Optional.
form.note_review: Did you leave a review on the site?

selection.select_page: Select all shows on this page
selection.hidden: ({n} of them hidden by the current filters)
selection.confirm_hidden: Warning: some of them are hidden by the current filters ({n}).
selection.edit_info: Shows the changes will be applied to: {n}
selection.edit_note: Fields left on "don't change" stay as they are. Platform, rating, quality and framing are not applied to gifts.
selection.nothing_to_change: Choose at least one field to change.
selection.invalid_duration: Duration must be a whole number of minutes (0 or more).
selection.edit_none: No show changed: they already had these values.
selection.edit_done_gifts: Shows updated: {n}. Platform, rating, quality and framing were not applied to the selected gifts ({regali}).

tags.label: 🏷️ Tags
tags.manage_hint: Rename a tag by typing in its field: the new name applies to every show that uses it.
tags.confirm_delete: Delete the tag "{nome}"? It will also be removed from the shows that use it ({n}).
tags.duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.
tags.empty_name: The tag name cannot be empty.
tags.empty_form: No tags yet: type one below.
tags.bulk_hint: Click a tag: + add, then − remove, then back to no change.

sites.label: 🌐 Site
sites.manage_hint: The site is where you bought the show. Untick the sites you don't use: they disappear from the form (and, for Mondo Cam Girls, its features are switched off). Name, label, currency and colour apply at once to every show of that site.
sites.name: Site name
sites.in_use: Used by {n} shows: move them to another site first with bulk edit.
sites.cannot_delete_mcg: Mondo Cam Girls cannot be deleted.
sites.duplicate: A site with this name already exists.
sites.empty_name: The site name cannot be empty.
sites.rate: Value of 1 unit in euros (indicative rate, please check)
sites.active_hint: In use: shown in the form; for Mondo Cam Girls it enables its features
sites.need_one: At least one site must stay in use.

csv.title: 📥 Import from CSV
csv.import_hint: Import the purchase history downloaded from any cam site (CSV file): choose the columns, the site and the currency, check the preview and confirm.
csv.export_hint: Save the whole history to a CSV file that Excel can open and the app can re-import.
csv.note: Rows already in the archive (same model at the same date and time) and rows with errors are skipped. Imported shows have no rating (TBD): you can complete them later.
csv.done: Imported {n} shows. Already there: {doppioni}. Rows with errors: {errori}.
csv.empty: The file contains no rows to import.

privacy.pin_note: The PIN locks the app at startup, after the chosen idle time and with the hide shortcut. It protects the open app but does not encrypt the data files. If you forget it, delete preferenze.json from the data folder.
privacy.pin_invalid: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
privacy.pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
privacy.wait: Too many attempts: try again in {s} seconds.
privacy.hotkey_modificatore: {tasti}: use Ctrl or Alt with a letter or a number (or a key from F1 to F12).
privacy.hotkey_riservata: {tasti} is already used by the app or the system.
privacy.hotkey_non_valida: {tasti}: use a letter, a number or an F key.

ranking.title: 🏆 General Models Ranking
ranking.info_rule1_text: Models are ranked first by the average of the ratings they received (1 to 5 stars). Gifted shows or shows marked as TBD do not affect the average.
ranking.info_rule2_text: With equal average ratings, the model with more shows is ranked higher.
ranking.colors_cost: Avg €/min: green if the model costs less per minute than your average, red if more (beyond ±10%); no color when close to the average.
ranking.colors_rating: Average Rating: in amber, to spot it at a glance.
ranking.colors_votes: Rating of each show (model card and history): green 5, teal 4, amber 3, red 1-2, grey not yet rated.
ranking.colors_missing: Not available: duration not recorded or €/min not computable (shows without duration or gifts).

suspended.tooltip: Profile temporarily suspended on MondoCamGirls: shows cannot be purchased (checked on {data})
suspended.removed: This profile no longer exists on MondoCamGirls (checked on {data})

budget.title: Monthly Target & Budget
budget.not_set_sub: No monthly budget set. Set it in the Statistics tab.
budget.exceeded_warning: WARNING! You exceeded your budget by

table.name: Name
table.cost_per_minute_hint: Average based only on shows with a recorded duration (gifts excluded)
table.cost_per_minute_compare: Your average across all shows: {media}. Green = cheaper, red = more expensive (beyond ±10%)

modal.no_photos: ⚠️ No photos found on the page:

models.merge_tip: Merge into this model the shows recorded under another name (e.g. the same model on another site)
models.split_tip: Move the shows of one site to another model (same name, different people)
models.merge_placeholder: Name of the model to merge
models.split_preview: Shows to move: {n} on {sito}, from “{da}” to “{a}”.
models.joins_existing: “{a}” already exists: the shows will be added to hers.
models.note: Every show remembers the name it was bought under: the Mondo Cam Girls sync recognises shows already imported and assigns new ones to the right model.

chat.teams_copy_hint: {nick}: click to copy the name and open Teams, then paste it in the search (with the email the chat opens directly)
chat.teams_copied:
📋 "{nick}" copied to the clipboard.

Teams is opening: paste the name in the search bar at the top or in the "To:" field of the new chat.
chat.teams_not_copied:
"{nick}" could not be copied to the clipboard.

Teams is opening: search for the name in the search bar at the top.

settings.notes_full_hint: Complete notes and tags in the history, month detail and model card, without clicking.
settings.autosave: 💾 Settings are saved automatically and kept when you reopen the app, as are table order and filters.

log.hint: The log is not protected by the PIN: at the “Everything” level it also records the actions you take.
log.confirm_clear: Clear the log? This cannot be undone.
log.save_error: Could not save the log level
log.open_error: Could not open the log (it may still be empty)

credit.tip: Available credit on Mondo Cam Girls (read on {data})
credit.login_needed: MCG asks you to log in again: use Sync MCG to update the credit.

quote.title: 💶 Quote
quote.intro: How much a show should cost before you buy it, based on your previous shows with the model and on your average across all shows.
quote.choose_model: Type a model name to see the quote.
quote.based_on_site: Based on her last {n} shows on {sito}.
quote.based_on_all: Based on her last {n} shows, on all sites.
quote.based_on_all_few: Based on her last {n} shows on all sites: she has fewer than 2 on the chosen site.
quote.no_data: Not enough data: no show with a duration recorded with {nome}. Your overall average is used as reference.
quote.no_avg: No overall average yet: record shows with their duration.
quote.table_hint: Suggested price = average €/min of the last 5 shows with a duration (gifts and refunds excluded). Click a header to sort (e.g. most expensive first), a row to use it in the quote, 👤 to open the model card.
quote.table_empty: No model with shows of known duration.
quote.card_hint: her suggested price {valore}/min · with your average {tua}
quote.card_no_data: not enough data · with your average {tua}
quote.form_expected_general: 💶 Expected for {min} min with your average: {tua} (no show with a duration with her)
quote.sort_hint: Click to sort; click again to reverse
quote.no_online: None of these models is online on Mondo Cam Girls right now.
